guides.title: 玻璃穿孔製作：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Through-glass-via fabrication: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 玻璃通孔與矽通孔的材料破壞不同。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Glass and silicon vias have different fracture behavior. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。圖中為矽微柱，不是玻璃通孔 TGV，也不能據此推定玻璃加工形貌。 觀察側壁波紋與錐度；圖片沒有提供可複製的完整設備配方。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：玻璃通孔與矽通孔的材料破壞不同。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以裂紋、錐角及金屬附著力驗證。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. These are silicon micropillars, not through-glass vias, and do not establish glass-processing morphology. Observe scallops and taper; the image does not supply a reproducible complete tool recipe.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Glass and silicon vias have different fracture behavior. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Verify cracks, taper and metal adhesion. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以裂紋、錐角及金屬附著力驗證」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Verify cracks, taper and metal adhesion, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

sources.title: AIM Photonics: Test, Assembly and Packaging

guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 玻璃穿孔製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.concept: 先用「玻璃組成」建立判讀邊界。玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Glass composition to define the interpretation boundary. CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜玻璃組成：指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜種子覆蓋：檢查入口、中央和出口截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜整合放行：保存孔群位置和失效類型。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Glass composition: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Seed coverage: Inspect entrance, middle and exit sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Integration release: Retain array location and failure class. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「種子覆蓋」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Seed coverage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration release to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：雙面表面有種子即可證明孔壁相連。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating all glass as one material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Inferring wall continuity from seeded faces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：玻璃孔洞、裂紋與金屬化。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。

related.differenceEn: Glass is brittle/insulating; Si TSVs include semiconductor substrates and insulation
practice: 以「玻璃組成」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。

practiceEn: Use glass composition to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing.
Using "Specify material grade and measurement frequency.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

history.textEn: ASE’s history records volume flip-chip production, providing a milestone for comparing wire-bond and area-array interconnect approaches.

courses.connection: 由玻璃孔洞、裂紋與金屬化延伸到相近課程，沿接口比較材料、幾何、量測與驗收，而不是直接複製設定。
courses.connectionEn: Follow glass vias, cracking and metallization into related courses by comparing materials, geometry, measurement and acceptance at interfaces instead of copying settings.

courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Through-glass-via fabrication. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
